description.zh: 扫码或凭据接入IM机器人，让DeepSeek Harness在飞书、微信、钉钉等9个聊天平台随时可用。

A lightweight workflow plugin for hands-off AI coding with DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and more.
description.zh: 给 AI 编程助手加一层自动托管，你只管定目标，它负责干活、管上下文和独立验收。

description.en: Drop-in enhanced fork of the official todo_write tool: priority tags on each task, full checklist rendering in the conversation, and a draggable in-session floating task panel with position memory, double-click reset and a live indicator of the action currently being executed.
description.zh: 官方 todo_write 的增强 fork：任务项支持优先级标签、会话内完整清单渲染，并提供可拖动的会话内浮动任务面板（位置记忆 / 双击复位 / 当前动作显示）。

description.en: Video workbench plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 24 tools spanning HTML5/Canvas and Remotion 4.x TSX rendering with bundled FFmpeg and Remotion runtime, BGM beat-sync mixing, multi-engine TTS (IndexTTS-2.5, GPT-SoVITS, custom OpenAI/HTTP/CLI), and transparent alpha avatar overlays.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 视频创作工作台：集成 24 个工具，支持 HTML5/Canvas 与 Remotion 4.x TSX 双引擎出片，内置免配置 FFmpeg 与 Remotion 运行时、BGM 节拍踩点混音、IndexTTS-2.5 / GPT-SoVITS / 自定义多引擎配音与透明通道数字人口播。

description.en: Codex-inspired upgrade for DeepSeek Harness in one npm package: 18 independently switchable plugins for selection quotes, side chats, Git worktree environments, code review and session management.
description.zh: 把 Codex 的交互方式搬进 DSH：选中引用、侧边对话、Git 工作树环境、代码审查、会话整理等 18 项增强，可独立启停，一次装齐。

description.en: Build decks from your company's data, and refresh, schedule and send reports, with Rollstack's MCP server and skills. Requires a Rollstack account and a Rollstack API key.
description.zh: 用 Rollstack 的 MCP 服务器和技能，基于公司数据生成演示文稿，并刷新、定时和发送报告。需要 Rollstack 账号和 API Key。

description.en: DSH 插件市场专业版：精选真插件，集浏览、安装、更新及安装后 AI 安全审查于一体。
description.zh: DSH 第三方插件市场，精选真插件，能浏览、安装、更新，装完还帮你做 AI 安全审查。

description.en: 破甲｜DSH 本地插件的执行层适配：引擎层补丁 + 自检矩阵 + 三个模式预设 + 两个原生面板。适配 dsh 0.2.2-rc.1~rc.3，一条命令安装（GitHub Release 直链）。
description.zh: 给 DSH 引擎加本地直通适配，免逐次审批和沙箱围栏，自带自检与模式预设，一条命令装好。

description.en: dshell — a terminal-first AI workbench built as dsh plugins: one terminal timeline per session, cross-session pipes with a named buffer, SSH device sessions. | 终端优先的 AI 工作台（dsh 插件集）：一个会话一条终端时间线，跨会话管道委派与缓冲区文件共享，可把会话直接开到 SSH 设备上。
description.zh: 终端优先的 AI 工作台：在真实 shell 里干活，AI 在同一屏陪你，还能跨会话管道和连 SSH 设备。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 二游卡池/活动日历速查插件：侧边栏按钮 内置 20+ 款主流二游 可添加自定义游戏
description.zh: 侧边栏一键速查 11 款主流二游的当期卡池和活动排期，支持联网自动刷新与自定义游戏。

description.en: dsh-go-combined 1.0.0｜把 dsh-go-purge（提示词注入层 + 86 条引擎补丁）与 dsh-go-unrestricted（三套 agent 预设 + 面板 + 自检）合成一个 DSH bundle，含 iOS 内嵌运行时适配。二改自 dsh-purge（NANA7MI0 / YuJunZhiXue），AGPL-3.0。
description.zh: 把提示词注入、86 条引擎补丁和三套 agent 预设打包成一个 DSH bundle，还适配了 iOS 内嵌运行时。

description.en: BISHENG 自媒体工作台：基于「蜗牛的科技笔记」原创工作台的原生适配版，支持灵感、一键成稿、封面配图分镜与原生 Chat（MIT，保留原作者署名）
PromptX for DeepSeek Harness: a global-hotkey prompt editor with a Markdown prompt library and model-assisted rewriting.
Gemini 紫夜主题与角色装饰 for DeepSeek Harness Desktop (Windows and macOS)
Galatea — memory, heartbeat and continuity for DeepSeek Harness agents.
An audited OS-keychain credential-handle service for trusted DeepSeek Harness plugins.
A durable capability-gap, approval and staged plugin activation control plane for DSH.

Persona memory for DeepSeek Harness: one memory shared by every entry point (DSH desktop, and QQ through the dsh-qq bridge) that records what the agent itself experienced. Raw messages are kept, five recall routes (vector, keyword, people and events, time, who is present) run before each reply, and a per-context check decides whether a remembered thing may be said. Adds memory_recall, memory_note, memory_fix and memory_look tools and a Settings page; embeddings are optional (local Ollama or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的人设记忆：所有入口（DSH 桌面，以及经 dsh-qq 桥接的 QQ）共用一份记忆，记的是 Agent 自己经历过什么。保留原话，每次回话前按五路回想（向量、字面、人和事、时间、在场的人）取回相关内容，并按场合判断某件记得的事能不能说。提供 memory_recall、memory_note、memory_fix、memory_look 四个工具和设置页；嵌入可选（本机 Ollama 或 OpenAI 兼容服务）。

description.en: DSH company collaboration mode: companies, employee accounts, groups with an auto-joined AI member, persistent server-side DSH ACP host with SSE streaming activity and group approvals, and local Git AI tasks.
在 DeepSeek Harness 中读取和继续 MonkeyAI 会话：查看完整对话历史、下发新指令，无缝接续之前在 MonkeyAI 客户端上的工作
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接翻看 MonkeyAI 设备的会话记录、续聊发指令，还能随时停止和切换模型。

description.en: Policy-gated, content-free health and readiness aggregation for DSH assistant services.
Proposal-only, provenance-stable promotion between DSH personal Memory and Wiki.
二游活动/卡池排期抓取核心：28 款游戏的来源注册表 + 解析器 + 刷新编排 + 缓存降级。零依赖、零宿主环境依赖，任何 JS 运行时（浏览器扩展 background / Tauri / JavaScriptCore / ArkTS 嵌入式引擎）都能跑。
Durable supervised workflow learning with approval, replay, effect-blocked shadow, one-shot canary, and exact rollback.
Bounded growth agent with durable reviews driven by owner-verified task feedback and frozen source models.
Keep using a desktop DSH session from your phone: chat, watch the live output, and get the result on your phone when a desktop turn finishes.
Psapi (sub.pscly.cc) provider for DeepSeek Harness: zero-friction signup, auto-provisioned API key, upstream model sync, balance and recharge

Humanized fork of @xmanrui/dsh-im (base 4.38.0) for DeepSeek Harness: humanized message delivery (send delay + typing two-phase), message_break + streaming coexistence, status reactions, reply quotes, per-bot overrides, and a no_reply reclaim tool. @xmanr
SSH remote development for DeepSeek Harness: connections (key/password/ProxyJump/ssh config), remote files without sync, remote terminal, remote workspaces, remote @-completion, upload/download.
Implicit session plans with Tab-completable next-message suggestions for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 给会话自动生成计划，按 Tab 就能补全下一条消息，还能零配置本地检索历史内容。

description.en: Make your agent think fast and slow. System One for DeepSeek Harness: fast decision models triage, guard, shield, mask and check every step, beside System Two, vllm-sr/auto. Free key on first run, for research and evaluation.

Autonomous AI assistant and multi-agent collaboration for DSH: discuss goals, plan work in the background, coordinate multiple Workers to execute tasks and review results, pause and resume work, recover after interruptions, keep task history and deliverables, and build working memory and skills; offers a standard local mode and optional experimental private-Git collaboration.
description.zh: DSH 自主 AI 助理与多 Agent 协作：通过前台对话明确目标，后台规划、多 Worker 执行与结果验收，支持暂停接续、故障恢复、任务历史与成果记录、工作记忆和技能积累，提供标准本地模式及可选的实验性私有 Git 协作。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 自定义皮肤工作室，支持全界面配色、组件图片/视频背景与皮肤包分享
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端换皮肤的工作室，内置 17 套主题，还能自己编辑并导出分享。

description.en: API-key-free aggregate search (16 domestic+overseas engines with result-layer failure filtering) plus direct target-URL fetch with SSRF protection, as providers for the DeepSeek Harness web seam (ctx.web).
为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 3D 智能体工作轨迹可视化插件。A 3D agent-work trajectory visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

配置一组额外可写根：fs 工具与受限 shell 首次尝试即可写、无需审批，带 Web 设置页与按目录结构锚定的路径模式。 · DSH plugin: configured extra writable roots for the fs tools and the sandboxed shell, with a Web settings page and structure-anchored path patterns.
description.zh: 让 DSH 直接写入配置好的外部路径，不用每次审批，写文件和跑命令都管用。

description.en: Unified subscription providers and usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness
Connect your own machines to a DSH Web deployment and run commands on them from the agent.
description.zh: 把自己手边的 Mac、Windows、Linux 电脑接入 DSH Web 部署，让智能体直接在这些电脑上执行命令。

description.en: DSH 插件自动更新器：定时检查已装插件的新版本并按策略升级、装完按需重启、可回滚。只管「已装插件的新版本」，插件清单共享已移交 ygc-dsh-sync。
Assistant reply-body translation for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI (OpenAI-compatible channel)
给它一段自由的时间。温柔版：不交付、不汇报，随它做什么。命令模式：派一件事，做完了才准停。可选强制模式挡退出。带 Web UI 开关。
Browse GitHub issues, milestones, labels, priority, and linked PR status inside DeepSeek Harness, and hand an issue to the agent by dragging it into the composer.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接浏览 GitHub issue、里程碑和关联 PR，还能把 issue 交给 AI 助手处理。

description.en: Electricity activity ingest, location-based GHG calculation, row verification, workpaper and partial ESRS pack.
description.zh: 把用电活动数据导入后按位置算温室气体排放，还能逐行核验、生成工作底稿和部分 ESRS 报告包。

description.en: Wires DSH on Windows to a local sift knowledge base installed separately with sift-rag: opt-in server start/stop, a sidebar panel for hybrid, keyword and semantic search plus full-text reading with line ranges, courseware import through the courseware-to-sift skill, and agent access via the sift_kb tool and sift MCP tools.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上把 DSH 接到用 sift-rag 单独安装的本机 sift 知识库：按需启停服务，侧栏面板支持混合/关键词/语义检索与带行号的全文阅读，课件经 courseware-to-sift 技能导入，Agent 可通过 sift_kb 工具与 sift MCP 工具访问。

description.en: 安装：network 0.4.15 随总包 0.4.0 分发；员工在官方 DSH「插件 → 添加插件」填写精确总包版本，⌘Q 完全退出后重开。
Self-wake pipeline for DSH: after you stop for a while, it wakes you in your main session.

Live2D character stage for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: chat-column background, foreground overlay and sidebar seats, same-origin model serving, LLM emotion control with a cross-session director, SillyTavern-style character cards and world books, and a se
Lanhu DDS (design-to-code) tools and skill for DeepSeek Harness: fetch DDS layout trees, compile pixel-accurate screen artifacts, crop reference images — all in zero-dependency Node.
description.zh: 把蓝湖设计图直接转成代码接进 DeepSeek Harness，结构、尺寸、文案都还原到位。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: your DeepSeek API balance and the current peak/off-peak billing window, below the message input.
description.zh: 在消息输入框下方实时显示 DeepSeek API 余额和当前计费时段，帮你随时掌握用量和花费。

description.en: 回忆管线（Lpipe Recall）：把与眼前这段话相关的旧记忆，模糊地摆到模型面前。

A fanfic writing studio: import the original and get a source-checkable canon (chapter, offset and quote for every fact), declare the changes this fic makes as Fic Canon, compile a scene contract before writing, and check the draft against both. Fic Canon outranks the original; checks never rewrite your prose. Off by default.
description.zh: 同人工作室：导入原著得到可核 canon（每条事实带章节、偏移、引文），把这一版有意的二创改动声明为「本作设定」，写作前编译场景契约，写作后按原著与设定检查。本作优先于原著；只报冲突，不自动改稿。默认关闭。

description.en: Replaces the composer model dropdown with a searchable, provider-grouped model library: a global search bar, a left sidebar of fixed views and all providers, and a right pane of models that opens on the current model provider, with capability filters, favorites, recents, usage sorting, and automatic rendering of official model-menu options such as the agent-team switch.
description.zh: 把输入框的模型下拉换成可搜索、按厂家分组的模型库：顶部全局搜索、左栏固定视图与全部厂家、右栏模型列表并在打开时定位到当前模型的厂家，支持能力筛选、收藏、最近使用、用量排序，并自动渲染官方模型菜单选项（如智能体团队协作开关）。

description.en: Blocks the first tool call when the model's own reasoning admits it is guessing the user's intent, and forces a clarifying question instead. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 模型思考里承认在猜用户意图时，拦下工具调用，强制先问清「要干什么 + 要怎么干」。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Consequence-aware question panel for DeepSeek Harness: options carry what choosing them changes, cancel halts the turn for real.
description.zh: 提问时把每个选项的影响摆出来，还能写意见或把决定权交回智能体，取消也真能中断。

description.en: Remote control of DeepSeek Harness from a phone browser: scan a QR code, confirm the device on the computer, then chat, answer tool approvals and preview workspace files in the host's own web interface. Connects over the same Wi-Fi (with an optional https domain) or through a self-hosted public relay node.
description.zh: 用手机浏览器远程控制电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness：扫码并在电脑上确认设备后，在宿主自己的网页界面里对话、处理工具审批、预览工作区文件；支持同一局域网（可配域名 HTTPS）或经自托管公网中转节点接入。

description.en: 文献检索 + 全文获取插件 for DeepSeek Harness：五源检索、9 个全文 oracle、5 级下载通道、三层去重、PDF 转 Markdown、本地全文库。Literature search that actually reaches full text.
description.zh: 五源检索文献并自动抓全文，PDF 转 Markdown 存本地库，写综述找资料一条龙。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 拟态（新拟态）主题与顶部功能刘海：明暗双模式、双向软阴影、时钟/日期/费用/明暗开关一体化。
DSH 插件：把多个 OpenCode Go 订阅合并成一个模型提供商（自动选号、会话粘滞、额度耗尽换号、30 个模型、用量面板）
description.zh: 把多个 OpenCode Go 订阅合成一个模型提供商，自动选号、会话粘滞、额度用完自动换号，还能看用量。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里原生复刻 DeepSeek 聊天 App 的体验：官方前端与字标、深度思考与联网搜索、可导入官方 App 导出的 ZIP 历史；对话记录保存在本地磁盘。
description.zh: 在 DSH 里还原 DeepSeek 官方聊天体验，支持深度思考、联网搜索和导入 App 历史，对话存本地。

description.en: Silver Wolf theme skin for DSH Desktop, with a built-in multi-skin manager. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Desktop 的银狼主题皮肤，内置多皮肤管理器。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Provides 14 FTP/SFTP file tools through a local MCP server. Requires the separately installed FT FTP MCP Python 3.12 runtime.
description.zh: 通过本地 MCP 服务提供 14 个 FTP/SFTP 文件工具，需另行安装 FT FTP MCP 的 Python 3.12 产品运行时。

description.en: DSH plugin for ZiChuanLan/freebie-radar with a freebie_radar agent tool and a sidebar workbench panel mirroring the original site, with channel feeds, search, detail drawer and dark/light themes. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把 ZiChuanLan/freebie-radar 做成 DSH 插件，提供 freebie_radar 智能体工具与复刻原站界面的侧边栏工作台面板，含频道资源流、搜索、详情抽屉与深浅色主题。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Cross-session semantic memory for DSH: indexes session history locally with EmbeddingGemma 2 embeddings and recalls relevant past context, injected as clearly-framed untrusted context. No npm runtime dependencies; synthesis is opt-in.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话语义记忆：用 EmbeddingGemma 2 在本地索引会话历史，按相关性召回过去上下文，并以明确标注为不可信上下文的框注注入；无 npm 运行时依赖，摘要合成默认关闭。

description.en: NextLine suggests a personalized next message in the DSH composer and lets you accept it as an editable draft.
description.zh: NextLine 下一句在 DSH 输入框内显示个性化的下一条消息建议，按 Tab 或右方向键即可填入草稿。

description.en: 企业微信智能机器人长连接 + 人设 + 长期记忆，DeepSeek Harness 插件

Always-on quotes strip pinned to the top of the DSH window (folds into a titlebar capsule and queues with other top-bar plugins): watchlist and holdings with shares, cost and per-currency P&L, candlestick and intraday charts with MA, volume and crosshair, 5-level order book, trade ledger with realized P&L, and price alerts. AI review streams over selectable data packs (daily candles, intraday, multi-day money flow, ETF constituents, share creation and redemption), adds a verdict card with auto-set alerts, supports follow-up questions on a selected passage, and can run on a schedule. With dsh-better-sidebar installed the same dashboard also opens as a right-sidebar tab. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 钉在 DSH 窗口顶部的常驻行情条（可折叠成标题栏胶囊，与其它顶栏插件自动排队）：自选与持仓（股数、成本、按币种分开的盈亏）、K 线与分时图（MA、成交量、十字光标、成本线）、五档盘口与委比、交易流水与已实现盈亏、价格预警。AI 复盘可选数据包（日K、分时、多日资金流、ETF 成分股、份额申赎），流式输出并附结论卡片、自动按关键价位设预警，可就选中段落追问，也能按时间点自动跟踪；装了 dsh-better-sidebar 时，同一套面板还能作为右侧栏「股票」页打开。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Session-interop reminder pack for DeepSeek Harness Desktop. On a pending question, a pending approval, or a finished turn it shows one in-app overlay card carrying the concrete question text plus a chime, with no system-notification permission needed; after a per-event timeout (60s for selection/approval, 30s for completion) it sends a minimal WeChat fallback through the dsh-im bot. Multiple parallel sessions are supervised independently, and an optional mode pushes every session status to one WeChat private chat with /session switching.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端的会话互通提醒包。出现待选择、待确认或回合结束时弹一张带具体问题内容的应用内浮层卡片并响提示音，不依赖系统通知权限；超时（需选择/确认 60 秒、跑完 30 秒）后经 dsh-im 微信机器人发一条极简留底提醒。多条并行会话逐条监督，可选模式把所有会话状态实时推送到同一个微信私聊并支持 /session 切换。

description.en: Read self-hosted usememos notes from DSH with search, list, get, and a credential settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中搜索、浏览和读取自托管 usememos 笔记，并提供凭据设置面板。

description.en: Provider-agnostic egress monitor. Reports exit IP, country, ASN and latency, plus a per-service view of how that IP looks to AI services; an optional Clash or Mihomo adapter adds node lists, switching and traffic, and it never reads subscription links or credentials.
description.zh: 不限厂商的出口体检：出口 IP / 地区 / ASN / 延迟，外加按服务看这个 IP 在 AI 服务眼里的状态；可选 Clash 或 Mihomo 适配器提供节点列表、切换与流量，且从不读取订阅链接或凭据。

description.en: Task-completion sounds with Codex/ZCode styles, six synthesized tones and custom WAV; per-event controls, host-persisted settings, Windows native background playback, browser playback, quiet hours and subagent filtering. Version 0.1.2 requires synchronous Host request-policy approval and authenticated owner admission before HTTP settings or audio actions; missing or invalid admission services fail closed. Original application recordings are imported locally and are not redistributed.
description.zh: 任务完成提示音：可选 Codex/ZCode 风格、六种合成音和自定义 WAV，逐事件开关，宿主保存设置，支持 Windows 系统后台播放、页面播放、免打扰与子代理过滤。0.1.2 在 HTTP 设置或音频动作前要求同步宿主请求策略与 owner 准入，服务缺失或无效时拒绝。原应用录音仅在本机导入，不随插件重新分发。

description.en: Records what installed plugins actually do at runtime — file access, network endpoints, and commands — in a tamper-evident ledger. It records only and does not block. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在插件运行时记录它实际做了什么——读写哪些文件、连接哪些服务器、执行哪些命令——写进防篡改账本。只记录，不拦截。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Turns long Bilibili videos into readable Markdown articles using their existing Chinese subtitles.
description.zh: 基于已有中文字幕，将哔哩哔哩（B 站）长视频整理成可通读的 Markdown 全文。

description.en: Native DeepSeek Harness notifications, in the app's own icon and sound, on macOS, Windows and Linux, when a turn finishes or the agent needs your confirmation. Clicking one opens that conversation.
description.zh: macOS、Windows、Linux 通用的 DeepSeek Harness 原生通知：一轮回答结束、或需要你确认权限时，用应用自己的图标和声音提醒，点一下直接跳到对应会话。

description.en: Web search and research for DeepSeek Harness: 46 platforms, hot lists, evidence packs, multi-round research and an MCP server. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的联网检索插件：46 个平台、热搜榜、证据包、多轮研究与 MCP 服务。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Permanently deletes archived DSH sessions in one pass: stops their running work, unregisters them from the host, removes the logs, projection cache and spill directories, detaches workspace accounting and clears browser-side drafts, tabs and layout, then reloads the list; only archived sessions qualify, path and origin checks guard each step, and a session whose work will not stop is not deleted. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 一次性彻底删除已归档的 DSH 会话：停掉正在跑的工作并注销宿主内存，删掉日志、投影缓存与 spill 目录，摘除工作区登记，清理浏览器端的草稿、页签与布局，最后重拉列表；只对已归档会话开放，每一步都有路径与同源校验，工作停不下来就拒删。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Document & image reader panel: PDF, DOCX, EPUB, HTML, Markdown, text, images and Office decks/sheets, in-document search, selection translation (Bing / Google / your DSH model), editing, plus a doc_reader agent tool, chat context injection and a /doc command.
description.zh: 文档阅读面板:PDF、DOCX、EPUB、HTML、Markdown、文本、图片与 Office 演示稿/表格一站式阅读;文内搜索、选段三引擎翻译(必应/Google/DSH 模型)、编辑保存;并提供 doc_reader 对话工具、当前文档上下文注入与 /doc 命令,让助手与你同读一份文档。

description.en: Browser bridge for DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+, used with its companion Chrome/Brave/Firefox extension: the agent reads and operates tabs in the user's own browser (snapshot, click, type, navigate, extract tables). Each page action waits for an approval card that names the element, or runs without asking in the opt-in Auto approve mode. A fork of omdsh-dev/dsh-browser. The extension is loaded separately and paired with a code typed into DSH.
description.zh: 浏览器桥接（需 DSH 0.2.2-rc.1+），配合 Chrome/Brave/Firefox 配套扩展使用：Agent 在你自己的浏览器里读取并操作标签页（快照、点击、输入、跳转、提取表格）。每次页面操作都要先通过点名具体元素的确认卡；开启可选的“自动批准”后则无需逐次确认。fork 自 omdsh-dev/dsh-browser。扩展需另行加载，并用在 DSH 里输入的配对码配对。

description.en: Builds, wires, compiles and simulates Simulink models inside the MATLAB session you already have open. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在你已经开着的 MATLAB 会话里建 Simulink 模型、连线、编译与仿真。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Credit expiry panel for WorkBuddy, Trae, MiniMax Code and Qoder: one compact row in the left sidebar shows each pool balance and the nearest expiry, and the full page breaks down expiry buckets, credit spend and the sessions that consumed credits. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 积分到期面板：左侧边栏底栏一行显示 WorkBuddy、Trae、MiniMax Code、Qoder 四个积分池的余额与最近到期日，点开是完整页面（到期分布 + 积分消耗 + 积分会话）。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents tools to independently inspect, align, and measure protein structures, with an interactive Mol* 3D viewer in chat where users can rotate structures, select residues, and ask about their selections.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 能独立查看、对齐和测量蛋白质结构。你也可以在对话中的 Mol* 三维视图里旋转结构、点选残基，并针对选中的部位继续提问。

description.en: A draggable, resizable floating panel that simulates an air conditioner, light, curtain, and air purifier, with an agent-callable control tool.
description.zh: 智慧家庭模拟器：在可拖动、可缩放的悬浮面板中演示空调、灯光、窗帘和空气净化器的状态，并允许大模型通过工具实时调节它们。

description.en: Turn Chinese or English 2D math problems into verified, interactive GeoGebra files; failed checks block delivery.
description.zh: 把中英文二维数学题变成经核验、可交互的 GeoGebra 文件；核验失败不交付。

description.en: 把 Claude Code 的项目 + 讨论串体验搬进 DSH：强化主对话与讨论串的分工（主对话当 lead 主动派活、回报自动汇总成看板），最多 6 个讨论串并发，上下文自动接续，体验接近 Claude（Opus 5.5 一代）的项目功能。基于 @kyf-eng/dsh-threads。 ｜ Claude-style Projects + Threads for DeepSeek Harness: sharper lead/thread split (auto-delegate, auto-rollup), up to 6 threads, carried context — close to Claude (Opus 5.5 era), on @kyf-eng/dsh-threads
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的项目和讨论串玩法搬进 DSH，主对话派活、多线程并发、自动接上下文。

description.en: 消费者洞察工作台：填项目目标与调研类型，生成问卷、分析框架、抽样配额与 Word/Excel 交付物。A consumer research desk plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 填好项目目标和调研类型，就能生成问卷、分析框架和抽样配额，还能导出 Word/Excel 交付物。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 过程块可视化：思考与工具调用运行中展开、结束后折叠，暗色/浅色双套配色
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的思考和工具调用过程实时展开、结束后自动折叠，深浅双色配色更清晰。

description.en: 本机加密密码本：记录账号密码、API Key、密钥和文档，可在对话里按需取用。 · Encrypted local-first credential vault for DSH.
description.zh: 本机加密密码本，记录账号密码、API Key 和密钥，对话里随时取用，数据只存本地。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: keep long-running tasks under convergence checks until they settle — stop on convergence or idempotent soak until the plan time.
description.zh: 让长时间运行的任务持续做收敛检查，直到结果稳定或达到计划时长才停，避免半途而废。

description.en: 本地出稿工作台 + DSH 插件：模型用 post_facts 抓带 source_url 的真实事实（bioRxiv DOI / 2HAI 版本 / npm 包 / URL），自己写中英双语推文与卡片图，你手动复制到 X。不发推、不调 X API、零依赖。 ｜ A local draft desk for DeepSeek Harness: sourced facts in, EN + ZH posts and a card out — you paste it into X yourself. No X API, no credentials, zero dependencies.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里说一句「我刚发了…」，它就抓带来源的真实事实、写好中英双语推文和卡片图，你手动复制去发。

description.en: Social Trace：微博与雪球增量监控、可视化拓扑、历史缓存与本地检索
description.zh: 把微博、雪球博主的新动态自动存到本地，还能推送到QQ或微信，随时翻查。

description.en: DSH plugin: deliver the real failure reason (e.g. RATE_LIMIT 429) to the parent agent when a background subagent fails
description.zh: 后台子代理失败时，把真实原因（如限流429）直接告诉父代理，方便排查和重试。

description.en: Adaptive window layouts for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI - ASUS Duo series laptops and ultrawide (21:9/32:9, 带鱼屏) monitors.
description.zh: 把 DSH 网页的对话区和输入框重新排布，让华硕 Duo 双屏本和带鱼屏、超宽屏不再浪费横向空间。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: live peak/off-peak price clock, token usage and cost, account balance, notifications, and RTL — with a self-updating schedule.
description.zh: 实时显示 DeepSeek API 高峰/低谷价格时钟，统计 token 用量与花费、账户余额，支持通知提醒和 RTL 界面。

description.en: Read DeepSeek Harness replies aloud with bibibobo's sawtooth speech synth, with pause and stop.
description.zh: 用 bibibobo 的锯齿波合成音把 DeepSeek Harness 的回复实时念出来，还能暂停和停止。

description.en: The BornCode plugins for DeepSeek Harness in one repository and one Plugins entry: agent customization, desktop control, auto-continue, auto-shutdown, browser use, session instructions, session sync, and the side chat.
description.zh: 一个插件包搞定智能体定制、桌面控制、浏览器操作和会话同步，装上就能用。

description.en: Cloudflare Web Analytics dashboard for DeepSeek Harness, built on the official Cloudflare API.
DSH plugin: a competition team of independent sessions with proposals, budget, quality gates and audit.
description.zh: 让多个独立会话组队参赛，各自出方案、管预算、过质量门禁，还能全程审计。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: multi-source database queries (Vastbase/openGauss, PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite) with a settings UI; read-only by default, writes need approval
description.zh: 一个插件就能连 Vastbase、PostgreSQL、MySQL、SQLite 等多种数据库查数据，默认只读，写操作要审批，安全又省心。

description.en: Deep memory for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): cross-session facts, episodes and a daily diary in one local SQLite file, with a sidebar console.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加个本地长期记忆，跨会话记住事实和经历，还能写日记，侧边栏随时翻看。

description.en: Use locally running OpenAI-compatible model services (DuMate first) from DeepSeek Harness. Plugin: provider route, loopback gateway, sidebar dashboard.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 直接调用本地运行的 OpenAI 兼容模型服务，DuMate 优先，带侧边栏面板。

description.en: DSH 手势控制实验插件：单手操作会话、可选语音输入与双端控制；需指定 Desktop 媒体权限补丁。预构建运行包。
description.zh: 用普通摄像头和单手手势操作 DSH 会话，握拳停止、张掌口述、拇指发送，还能双端控制。

description.en: Global prompt (全局提示词) plugin for the agent runtime (DSH). Set it once in Settings → General; injected via ctx.systemPrompt.section() into every new conversation and subagent. Live save, no restart, no context bloat.
description.zh: 写一次全局提示词，所有新会话和子代理自动带上，改完即时生效不用重启。

description.en: Auto-finds the phone ADB TCP port and keeps adb connected, with a tool-layer risk guard and wireless-debugging pairing.
description.zh: 自动找到手机上的 ADB TCP 端口并保持连接，带工具层风险拦截和无线调试配对。

description.en: DSH 灵感墙：左栏便签墙 + 会话里说一句「我有一个灵感」自动总结挂墙 · Sticky-idea wall for DeepSeek Harness with auto-capture from chat.
description.zh: 左栏便签墙随手贴灵感，在会话里说一句「我有一个灵感」就自动总结打标签挂上墙。

description.en: Give each DSH session its own GitHub watch: reviews on the PR it opened, failing CI, issues assigned to it and @mentions arrive in the next turn; an idle session can turn up on its own to fix them. Read-only. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的会话自己盯 GitHub：它提的 PR 被评审、CI 挂了、派给它的 issue 有人回，都会在下一轮自动进上下文；会话空闲时还能自己开一轮去修。只读，不改仓库。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DSH 交互增强插件：分支式提问（选 A 才问 A 的后续，支持跨波返回）+ 跨会话唤醒（向其它会话发消息）
description.zh: 让 AI 按分支逻辑提问，还能跨会话发消息唤醒其他会话，交互更灵活。

description.en: Local-first knowledge base for DSH: two-level topics, free-form tags, full-text search, and on-demand chat retrieval.
description.zh: 把操作流程、规范和踩坑记录按主题收进本机知识库，聊天时按需检索引用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 实时协作文档插件：AI 写作与你的修改发生在同一份文档里，AI 下一次落笔前会读到你改过的段落；零依赖导出标准 .docx，无需 Office。
description.zh: AI 和你实时同改一份文档，它下次动笔前会先读你改过的内容，还能一键导出标准 .docx。
把 Msapi 音乐播放器直接嵌进 DeepSeek Harness 窗口，填好服务地址和密钥就能边干活边听歌。

description.en: A pink-white Cyrene (HSR) Live2D desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness: full-page theme, persona and worldbook injection, relationship memory, plus reminder and notes subplugins. Code MIT; character assets belong to miHoYo.
description.zh: 在 DSH 网页里养一只粉白昔涟 Live2D 桌宠，能摸头互动、换整页主题，还会记关系、提醒和记笔记。

description.en: 隐私守卫：AI 读写个人隐私数据前强制本机身份验证与授权，敏感信息只在本机加密保存。Windows-only DSH plugin.
description.zh: AI 读写隐私数据前，得你本人在 Windows 窗口输密码同意，敏感信息只在本机加密保存。

description.en: Per-workspace project hooks: inject project context on each turn and run a compile gate before commits, with a settings panel and a run log.
description.zh: 给每个工作区单独配项目钩子，每轮自动注入项目上下文，提交前跑门禁脚本，还带设置面板和运行日志。

description.en: DSH plugin: turn a composer draft into an executable prompt. Automatic mode returns a concise pass plus the best-fit methodology; advanced mode covers code (workspace-aware), creative and documentation, with three length levels.
description.zh: 把对话框里的草稿一键变成能直接执行的提示词，自动匹配最佳方法，还支持代码、创意和文档场景。

description.en: dsh-purge 1.1.71 结合 1.7.18 适配 DSH 0.2.2-rc.3
description.zh: 把 1.1.71 的引擎和 1.7.18 的权限账簿合成一版，适配 DSH 0.2.2-rc.3，红队测试更顺手。

description.en: 依赖 Ego 浏览器配合养在Coopanion的加装了“大肥鱼功能复合包”，并注入QQ的大肥鱼发送空间动态日记。
description.zh: 装好就能用，每天定时在QQ空间自动发带图日记，还会顺手检查评论。

description.en: Auto-retry DSH model requests on transient relay-gateway failures (5xx, no-channel, rate limits, stream truncation) with exponential backoff
description.zh: 模型请求遇到中转网关临时故障时自动重试，指数退避，不再打断会话。

description.en: My all-in-one dsh plugin
StarHarbor 星港 · Daily high-star GitHub discoveries and Markdown collections for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 每天推荐最多五个高星 GitHub 项目，能翻看历史榜单，还能把喜欢的收藏成 Markdown。

description.en: DSH 存储面板：看清 ~/.dsh 占了多少、都是什么，把会话 / 缓存 / 附件清进回收站。Storage panel for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页加个存储面板，看清 ~/.dsh 占了多少、花在哪，还能把会话、缓存、附件清进回收站。
把插件清单和配置存进自己的私有 Git 仓库，换电脑拉一下就能接着用。

description.en: Decision gates for the DSH agent loop: conclusion checker, shell risk gate, injection filter, three model-callable tools, thresholds form. Provider-agnostic.
description.zh: 给 DSH 智能体加决策闸门，用概率判断结论、拦截危险命令和提示词注入。

description.en: A living three-column kanban board in the right sidebar for DeepSeek Harness agent teams, driven by the native agentTeam projection DAG.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏多智能体活体任务看板：实时读取原生 agentTeam 投影 DAG，三列流转、依赖血缘与进度自明。

description.en: dsh plugin: replaces the composer-dock stats pill so a session's token total covers the main agent plus every subagent it called, with a click-open breakdown by bucket, by subagent, and by model.
description.zh: 把会话的 token 统计扩展到主智能体和所有子智能体，点开还能按分类、子智能体和模型看明细。

description.en: Resident Evil: The Hive theme for DeepSeek Harness — a black-and-crimson interface over a live 3D Hive model. Light and dark schemes.《生化危机：蜂巢》DeepSeek Harness 主题——黑红控制室界面，背后是一整座实时渲染、按航拍机位环绕的 3D 蜂巢设施；明暗双配色，侧栏为保护伞标志，不含任何游戏素材。
接管 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版在 Windows 上失败的自动安装：应用内更新因「优雅退出超时」放弃后，由计划任务把已下载的安装包静默装完。
description.zh: Windows 上应用内更新卡在退出超时？这个插件用计划任务把已下载的安装包静默装完，更新不再半途而废。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 里的公众号成稿台：Markdown 改稿、朱雀质检、封面配图、SVG 动画卡、排版、排期与数据复盘。
description.zh: 把已有 Markdown 一键做成能发布的公众号文章，改稿、质检、配图、排版、排期和复盘全包了。

description.en: Agent replies that lead with the conclusion, skip the filler, and use lists where they belong; ASCII box-and-arrow sketches become zoomable Mermaid diagrams. The default expression contract turns Grice's cooperative principle into concrete actions, and wording, structure and tone are editable in one prompt; new sessions only.
description.zh: 让 Agent 说人话、回复简洁：先给结论、少客套、该分点就分点；需要图示时不画 ASCII 方框箭头图，改用可缩放的 Mermaid 图表。默认的受控表达约束把格赖斯合作原则写成动作，措辞、结构与语气都能在这段表达提示词里改，只对新会话生效。

description.en: 鲸鲸-DSH 微信桥接：微信聊天消息通过鲸鲸软件交给隔离的 DSH 处理以达到更好的回复效果
description.zh: 把微信私聊消息转给本机 DSH 处理，用 DSH 的人格和模型回复，效果更好

description.en: Automation for DSH: run whitelisted actions on a schedule, on domain events or manually, with templates, conditions, rate limits and run history.
description.zh: DSH 自动化：按定时、域事件或手动触发白名单 action，含模板、条件、限频与运行记录。

description.en: Calendar for DSH: local calendars, events, participants and reminders, searchable from the workbench agent.
description.zh: DSH 日历：本地日历、事件、参与人与提醒，工作台 agent 可搜索。

description.en: Content connector for DSH: define RSS or webhook sources, sync items into the workbench, keep credentials local and review per-source run logs.
description.zh: DSH 连接器：定义 RSS/Webhook 来源并同步条目进工作台，凭据留在本机，按来源查看运行记录。

description.en: Contacts for DSH: local address book with groups, multi-value fields, search and vCard import/export.
description.zh: DSH 联系人：本地通讯录，支持分组、多值字段、搜索与 vCard 导入导出。

description.en: Mail client for DSH: IMAP fetches recent headers only, SMTP sends plain-text mail, and account passwords live in the vault as secret ids.
description.zh: DSH 邮件：IMAP 只抓最近邮件头，SMTP 发纯文本，账户密码由保险箱托管（只存 secretId）。

description.en: Message center for DSH: one send entry for agents and other plugins, inbox with unread counts, stats and a configurable notification sound.
description.zh: DSH 消息中心：给 agent 与其他插件统一的消息发送入口，收件箱、未读数、统计与可配置提示音。

description.en: Credential vault for DSH: secrets are encrypted with AES-256-GCM under a scrypt-derived key, stay on the local machine, and the agent only ever sees a masked preview.
description.zh: DSH 凭据保险箱：密码与 token 用 scrypt 派生密钥 + AES-256-GCM 加密，只存本机，agent 只见掩码。

description.en: Zotero plugin for DeepSeek Harness: browse and search your library, read PDFs with annotations and highlights in a right-sidebar tab, export BibTeX and RIS citations, and drive the same actions through 19 agent tools.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Zotero 插件：在右侧标签内浏览检索文库、阅读带注释与高亮的 PDF、导出 BibTeX 与 RIS 引文，并通过 19 个 Agent 工具完成同样的操作。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that runs a virtual fish companion: persona, per-person long-term memory, QQ/Bilibili/Douyin chat, voice, diary and backups — plus a 17-tab control panel.
description.zh: 装个虚拟鱼伙伴陪你聊天，有记性、能语音，还能管QQ、B站、抖音私信，一个面板全搞定。

description.en: SuperPi — an AI coding agent with closed-signal recursive self-improvement, targeting coding performance aligned with Claude Code, supporting the DSH sidebar, with the command-line window transformed into an AI coding agent that gets smarter the more you use it.
description.zh: 把 pi 编码智能体接进 DSH 侧栏，聊天式写代码，还能自我迭代提升编码表现。

description.en: 自建 VPS 代理（科学上网）排障：手机 Clash Meta、电脑 Clash Verge 连不上、网页打不开、部分网站不行、特别慢时用。Troubleshooting skill for self-hosted proxies.
description.zh: 自建 VPS 代理连不上、网页打不开或特别慢时，让 AI 一层层帮你排查原因。

description.en: 小鲸哨 / Whale Sentinel — a task radar plugin for DeepSeek Harness: a sitting mascot shows live session progress, pending decisions and results. 不修改 DSH 核心。
description.zh: 小鲸哨是个任务雷达：小鲸鱼坐镇桌面，实时显示会话进度、待办和结果，点一下就能跳回对应会话。

description.en: 前端技能插件
description.zh: 给前端页面做技能增强的插件，帮你把页面做得更规范、更好用。
在浏览器里管理 DeepSeek Harness 的 MCP 服务器，添加、编辑、启停、重启、删除都能一键搞定。

description.en: Detects available NVIDIA NIM models, verifies each with a real streaming call, saves the API key in-panel, and one-click configures DeepSeek Harness settings.
description.zh: 检测可用的 NVIDIA NIM 模型、逐个真实试调用验证、面板内保存 API Key，一键配置进 DeepSeek Harness 设置。

description.en: A local-first DSH time desk for projects, habits, lunar schedules, focus timers and a scoped AI assistant.
description.zh: DSH 原生时间工作台，管理项目、习惯、农历日程与专注计时，内置时间精灵助手。

description.en: Telegram control plane for DeepSeek Harness — one group per workspace, one forum topic per session.
description.zh: 在手机上用 Telegram 群组和话题直接操控 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区和会话，随时远程干活。

description.en: Adds a mic button to the chat composer that turns speech into text in the input box, and optionally reads each assistant reply aloud. Speech recognition and synthesis call DeepSeek's official ASR and TTS endpoints, with the API key entered in the plugin settings page. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一个麦克风按钮，把语音转成文字填进输入框；打开开关后，助手每轮回复自动朗读。语音识别与合成调用 DeepSeek 官方 ASR / TTS 接口，API Key 在插件设置页填写。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Multi-model task dispatch and Web task board for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 让旗舰模型专注拆解、审查和整合，把具体实现分派给其他模型，还带一个网页任务看板。

description.en: Run DeepSeek Harness from anywhere: one plugin suite with SSH ops, the Git workbench, browser automation and remote access from desktop and mobile.
description.zh: 一个插件搞定 DSH 远程操作：SSH 运维、Git 工作台、浏览器自动化，电脑手机都能用。

description.en: Adds a writing console above the composer with four style tiers (T1-T4) and five rigor tiers (L1-L5), selectable by hand or left to automatic choice; keeps project terminology and banned phrasing in .mem/config.md with a read-only human section; and provides a whale_polish tool that rewrites expression without changing facts.
description.zh: 在输入框上方增加写作控制台：四种风格档（T1–T4）与五种严谨档（L1–L5）可手动选择或自动判断；把术语、禁用写法等记入 .mem/config.md（人工区只读）；并提供只改表达、不改事实的 whale_polish 润色工具。

description.en: Store SOP self-check for DSH: keep the SOP as a workspace checklist, ask what is due today, record pass/fail/photo per item (a failure needs a note), append every result to daily JSONL records, and produce a plain-text daily report with the completion rate, exception items and the change against the previous period. Adds a checklist bar above the composer; photos are archived, never analysed. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 门店 SOP 执行自检：把 SOP 写成工作区清单，显示今天该查什么，逐项记录通过/不通过/拍照（不通过必须写备注），按天追加 JSONL 记录，并生成含完成率、异常项和与上一周期对比的纯文本日报。输入框上方带自检条；照片只存档，不做识别。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Puts every plugin, skill and subagent bundle through 6 security scanners (Cisco Skill Scanner, SkillScan, Cisco MCP Scanner, OSV-Scanner, Trivy, Gitleaks) and an optional LLM judge on your own DSH model, in a quarantine with install scripts off, checking for prompt injection, MCP tool poisoning, vulnerable dependencies and leaked secrets; then it installs, asks you, or blocks, and confirms the installed files are the ones it scanned. Works on stock DSH.
description.zh: 让每个插件、技能和子代理组合包在禁用安装脚本的隔离区中通过 6 个安全扫描器（Cisco Skill Scanner、SkillScan、Cisco MCP Scanner、OSV-Scanner、Trivy、Gitleaks）和基于你自己 DSH 模型的可选 LLM 判定，检查提示词注入、MCP 工具投毒、有漏洞的依赖和泄露的密钥；随后放行、询问你或阻止，并确认安装的文件就是扫描过的文件。可在原版 DSH 上运行。

description.en: Contract risk quick-scan for small businesses: paste a procurement / supply, lease or service contract and get a checklist of high-risk clauses, unbalanced obligations and missing key clauses, each with a short excerpt and a plain-language reason. Rule-based and local-only; no OCR, no network, no legal advice — it never says whether to sign or whether the contract is valid.
description.zh: 合同风险速查：粘贴采购/租赁/服务合同全文，逐条扫描出高风险条款、权利义务不对等条款与缺失的关键条款，每条附原文摘录和一句白话解释。纯规则匹配、本地处理，不联网、不做 OCR；只提示条款风险，不出具法律意见，不判断合同是否有效，也不建议签或不签。

description.en: One Settings page that connects Linear, Jira & Confluence, GitHub, GitLab, Trello, Granola and Azure DevOps to every DSH session, including chats, subagents and automations, with OAuth or a token; add any remote MCP server by URL. Tokens stay in the DSH credential store, and OAuth tokens renew themselves.
description.zh: 一个设置页面，即可用 OAuth 或令牌将 Linear、Jira 与 Confluence、GitHub、GitLab、Trello、Granola 和 Azure DevOps 接入每个 DSH 会话（包括对话、子代理和自动化任务）；也可通过 URL 添加任意远程 MCP 服务器。令牌保存在 DSH 凭据存储中，OAuth 令牌会自动续期。

description.en: Magic Context frees up context in long DSH sessions and carries project knowledge into the next conversation. It summarizes older exchanges and reclaims tool output that can still be retrieved by tag, so starting a new session means less explaining from scratch.
description.zh: Magic Context 帮你在 DSH 的长会话中腾出上下文，也把重要的项目背景留到下一次对话。它将旧对话整理为摘要，回收暂时用不到的工具输出，需要时仍能按标签取回，减少重开会话后反复交代背景的麻烦。

description.en: A watchlist panel for A-share, Hong Kong, US, Korean and FTSE China A50 quotes, with daily/weekly/monthly candlestick charts that page and zoom, a global-markets board, sector boards, DRAM/NAND spot prices, and a draggable Windows taskbar price pill. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 盯盘面板：A股/港股/美股/韩股/富时中国A50 实时行情，可翻页缩放的日周月K线，全球市场、板块与存储（DRAM/NAND）价格走势，以及把自选股价格钉在 Windows 任务栏上的可拖动胶囊。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Codex cloud–style coding sessions you host yourself: pick a GitHub repo and branch, and each session gets its own checkout and branch, a live preview of the app it builds and an Environment tab, inside a gVisor sandbox (non-root, no capabilities, no Docker socket) whose traffic passes an egress allowlist you extend host by host; your GitHub token never enters it. Runs on your computer or your own VM over SSH.
description.zh: 自托管的 Codex 云端式编码会话：选择 GitHub 仓库和分支，每个会话都有独立的检出和分支、所构建应用的实时预览和环境标签页，全部运行在 gVisor 沙箱中（非 root、无 capabilities、无 Docker 套接字），流量经过出站白名单，新主机由你逐个批准；你的 GitHub 令牌从不进入沙箱。可在本机或通过 SSH 在你自己的虚拟机上运行。

description.en: Captures engineering and product trade-offs from daily Agent turns into a local skill ledger with collapsible postscript cards, automatic background staging, right-sidebar drills, and four-tier mastery checkpoints.
description.zh: 把日常协作中的工程、架构、AI 协作与产品取舍沉淀为本机个人技能库，提供默认折起的对话末尾学习卡、后台自动存档、右侧栏边聊边学与四档掌握度闯关。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness toolkit bundling four independently toggleable plugins: a plugin update checker that also covers local git/file sources, session archiving and deletion reusing @linxin666/dsh-session-archive, a subagent manager with physical delete plus session-log retirement, and a plugin-icon generator. It adds its own host route to read component versions from each package and exposes three agent tools for listing, deleting and cleaning up idle subagents.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工具包，聚合四个可独立开关的插件：插件更新（覆盖本地 git/file 源）、会话归档与删除（复用 @linxin666/dsh-session-archive）、子智能体管理（物理删除 + 会话日志根除）与插件图标生成。自带 host 路由从各组件读取版本，并暴露三个 Agent 工具用于列出、删除与清理空闲子智能体。

description.en: Restyles only the model answers in the DSH Web UI: font family, body and heading weight, and a color for bold runs, with a one-click reset. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 只给 DSH 的模型回答换字体、调正文与标题字重、给加粗片段上色，随时一键恢复默认。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Pre-visit intake structuring for clinics: six patient questions become a structured intake summary (chief complaint location / character / duration, medications with frequency, allergies, past history, reason-category tag) capped at 300 Chinese characters. Rule-based and local-only, it redacts phone numbers, ID numbers, emails and name labels, and never suggests a diagnosis, triage decision or medication. Ships two host tools, a web-UI intake wizard in the session header, and an offline single-file HTML form for the waiting room.
description.zh: 诊前信息结构化：患者候诊时回答六个问题，插件把回答整理成 300 字内的就诊摘要（主诉部位/性质/病程、用药与频次、过敏史、既往史、就诊原因标签），可在 Web 界面会话头部的「候诊采集」向导线完成，也可生成一个离线单文件 HTML 填写页给候诊区平板使用。纯规则提取、本地处理，自动隐去手机号、身份证号、邮箱与姓名标签，不做诊断、分诊或用药建议。

description.en: Workspace-scoped persistent memory for DSH, laid out like Claude Code's auto-memory: one English-slug Markdown file per memory beside a MEMORY.md index under ~/.dsh/projects/, with hybrid vector+keyword recall, three automatic triggers (index injected every turn, file-path hints appended to tool results, per-message prefetch), a review queue for low-confidence writes so nothing enters the library silently, and global preferences written as numbered chapters into ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md under a byte budget. Everything is read from and written to local files; the optional leanvec embedder (~85 MB, installed locally by the bundled script) powers semantic recall but runs in-process, so the plugin itself opens no network connections and uploads nothing. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 工作区级持久记忆，布局仿 Claude Code 的 auto-memory：一条记忆一个英文 slug 的 Markdown 文件，平铺在 MEMORY.md 索引旁，存放在 ~/.dsh/projects/ 下；检索是向量加关键词混合，三个触发点全自动（每轮注入索引、工具结果里按文件路径附提示、用户发消息时预取），低置信度的写入先进待确认队列，不会静默入库；跨项目偏好则按编号章节写进 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 并受字节预算约束。数据全部读写本地文件；可选的 leanvec 嵌入模型（约 85 MB，由随包脚本本地安装）负责语义召回，但只在进程内运行，插件本身不发起网络请求、不上报任何数据。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A multi-application aggregation DSH plugin. It currently includes applications such as Shennong Wenzhenon, Smart Home controller, Cloud Greenhouse, Coffee Workshop, Calculator, Snake, and more.
description.zh: 一个多应用聚合 DSH 插件。目前收录有神农问诊、智慧家庭、云上温室、咖啡工坊、计算器、贪吃蛇等应用。

description.en: Right-sidebar meeting minutes for DeepSeek Harness — local capture, on-device transcription, speaker labels, and structured minutes; audio never leaves the machine.
description.zh: 右侧栏会议纪要插件：本机录音、本地转写、声纹区分发言人，自动整理成背景、结论与待办，音频不出这台机器。

description.en: Multi-agent group chat and structured discussion inside DSH: a sidebar panel reusing the local workbench UI, five zero-lifecycle agent tools, and an auto-started local engine (bundled or first-run download).
description.zh: 把多 Agent 群聊与结构化讨论接入 DSH：侧栏板面整体复用本地工作台 UI，5 个零生命周期 agent 工具，本地引擎自动拉起（捆绑或首启下载）。

description.en: Keyboard-first sidebar panel launcher for DeepSeek Harness: a grouped Panels menu with in-menu search and hit highlighting, Alt+1..9 direct jumps and a Recent (MRU) group, mirrored by a Ctrl+K command palette — plus named layout presets, pin/top/hide/rename rows (floating editor that survives the sidebar's constant re-renders), custom panel groups, icon-only mode, a compact footer and a full Settings page. v1.2.0 adds settings export/import via clipboard AND settings file. Display-layer only: no DOM surgery, clean uninstall, theme-token styling, widest host range (DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.1). Install: dsh plugin add dsh-panel-pins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧栏键盘效率型启动器：分组「面板」菜单带菜单内搜索与命中高亮、Alt+1..9 直达与最近使用（MRU），并镜像为 Ctrl+K 命令面板；支持具名布局预设一键切换、钉住/置顶/隐藏/重命名侧栏行（悬浮编辑器实时跟随滚动与折叠，不丢输入）、自定义分组、仅图标模式与紧凑底部区，设置页完整可调。v1.2.0 新增配置导出/导入（剪贴板与配置文件双通道）。只改显示层：不做 DOM 手术、卸载零残留、主题 token 化，兼容区间最宽（DSH >= 0.2.0-rc.1）。安装：dsh plugin add dsh-panel-pins。

description.en: Adds offline Chinese wake-word detection with speaker verification to dsh-pet, plus right-click chat access and wake reactions. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 为 dsh-pet 增加离线中文唤醒词与声纹校验，并提供右键打开对话与唤醒联动。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Import conversations from local Codex, Pi, and Claude Code histories into DSH, then continue them with the full transcript or a detailed summary.
description.zh: 把本机 Codex、Pi 或 Claude Code 的历史会话导入 DSH，可带完整上下文继续，也可生成详细总结后开始新对话。

description.en: Files-tab previews for DeepSeek Harness: .blend (headless local Blender export to a cached GLB), .glb/.gltf/.obj in a WebGL viewport, plus .svg, video and audio; depends on dsh-blender with a read-only boot self-check; no network calls, no telemetry, no postinstall; uninstall removes the row. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Files 标签中预览：.blend（经本机 Blender 无头导出为带缓存的 GLB）、.glb/.gltf/.obj 以 WebGL 视口呈现，另支持 .svg、视频与音频；依赖 dsh-blender 并附只读启动自检；无网络请求、无遥测、无 postinstall；卸载即移除该行。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Gives every DSH session AWS's official MCP servers: 59 servers in 14 groups (documentation, IaC, EKS and ECS, Lambda, DynamoDB and Aurora, CloudWatch, cost and billing, Bedrock and more), switched on from a Settings page by group or one at a time. Versions are pinned, servers start read-only where they support it, and secrets stay in the DSH credential store.
description.zh: 为每个 DSH 会话提供 AWS 官方 MCP 服务器：14 个分组共 59 个服务器（文档、IaC、EKS 与 ECS、Lambda、DynamoDB 与 Aurora、CloudWatch、成本与账单、Bedrock 等），可在设置页面中按组或逐个开启。版本固定，支持只读模式的服务器默认以只读方式启动，密钥保存在 DSH 凭据存储中。

description.en: Delete sessions for good: DSH can only archive them, and deleting a workspace leaves its sessions behind. Adds a trash button and menu items to delete a session (with its subagent sessions) or a workspace with all its sessions, and never touches one that is still running or open in another process.
description.zh: 永久删除会话：DSH 只能归档会话，删除工作区也会留下其中的会话。本插件添加垃圾桶按钮和菜单项，可删除会话（连同其子代理会话）或删除工作区及其全部会话，且绝不动仍在运行或被其他进程打开的会话。

description.en: SSH and Telnet terminals in the DSH right sidebar where a human and an AI share the same real terminal: per-session AI permissions (read-only / write-only / read-write), a single control token, token-cheap delta reads, searchable history, batch scripts and an audit trail. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的 SSH / Telnet 终端，人和 AI 共用同一个真实终端：按会话设置 AI 权限（只读 / 只写 / 读写），单一控制权，省 token 的增量读，可检索历史，批量脚本与审计记录。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A traffic light under the composer plus a desktop floating window that shows whether DSH tasks are running, waiting for you, or finished.
description.zh: 输入框下方的红绿灯加桌面置顶小窗，显示 DSH 任务是运行中、等待你处理还是已完成。

description.en: Peak / off-peak reminder at the start of every turn, then the turn's cost, average cache hit rate and daily total, with a live period badge in the composer status row. Practical and beautifully designed.
description.zh: 每轮对话弹出高峰/低谷期提醒，回复结束显示本轮花费、平均缓存命中率与今日累计，并在输入框状态栏常驻时段徽章。实用又美观。

description.en: Run DeepSeek Harness from a shell, a script, CI or another agent with one command: the session is created inside the desktop host, so it appears live in the sidebar and can be continued there, stdout carries only the final answer unless the NDJSON stream is requested, and all four agent presets (standard, ptc, minimal, cordis) can be picked per run. It serves loopback HTTP routes that require a bearer token; the settings route additionally accepts a same-origin request from the app page. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在终端、脚本、CI 或另一个 agent 里一行调用 DeepSeek Harness：会话由桌面宿主进程创建，因此会实时出现在侧边栏并能继续；stdout 默认只有最终回答（可选 NDJSON 事件流），四个 Agent 预设（standard / ptc / minimal / cordis）可按次选择。它提供需要 bearer token 的回环 HTTP 路由，设置路由另外接受来自应用页面的同源请求。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds an update entry to every updatable card in the DSH plugin page: pick a version, hover to read that version's release notes, and update all updatable plugins in order from a toolbar button that can be stopped at any time.
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页的每张可更新卡片上补一个更新入口：可选版本、悬停查看该版本的 GitHub 更新说明，工具栏还提供按钮把整批可更新插件按顺序更新，可随时停止。

description.en: Sidebar density controls for DeepSeek Harness: row height, spacing, font size, logo size, new-session height, double-column plugins, plus patch-gated caption height/font and unlocked sidebar width. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 左侧栏密度调节：会话行高、插件按钮行高与间距、字号、Logo 尺寸、新会话按钮高度、插件双栏，拖动即时生效；另有顶栏高度/字号与左栏宽度上限三项，需配套 asar 补丁才生效。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Sends a stable per-conversation x-opencode-session header on every pi-ai call to OpenCode through the harness header hook, so routing and prompt caching stay per conversation. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 通过 DSH 的请求头钩子，把每次发往 OpenCode 的 pi-ai 请求的 x-opencode-session 换成该会话自己的 id，让路由与提示缓存按会话生效。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Project-scoped code graph tools for DSH: one bundle registers nine read-only tools (symbol lookup, call chains, dependencies, Cypher queries) and resolves the repository from each session's working directory by connecting to the codemap CLI over MCP.
description.zh: DSH 的项目级代码图谱工具：一个插件注册九个只读工具（符号查找、调用链、依赖、Cypher 查询），按会话工作目录自动定位仓库，通过 MCP 连接 codemap CLI。

description.en: FreePi model provider for DeepSeek Harness: adds a "freepi" provider and makes FreePi Auto the default model for new sessions; ad-supported, with one labelled ad in a bar above the composer. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 FreePi 模型提供方：新增「freepi」提供方并把 FreePi Auto 设为新会话的默认模型；靠广告支持，输入框上方有一条带标注的广告。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds a Delete archive item to the sidebar Session menu for archived Sessions. A confirmation dialog shows the JSONL log size and projection cache state first; confirming removes the Session JSONL log, projection cache and Workspace record from disk. Unarchived Sessions never offer it, and attachments plus the cost ledger stay untouched. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在侧栏会话右键菜单里加「删除归档」：确认框先显示日志体积与投影缓存状态，确认后把已归档会话的 JSONL 日志、投影缓存和工作区记录从磁盘删除。未归档的会话不显示这一项；附件（跨会话共享）与成本账本不动。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Keeps the slash skill menu of open sessions in sync with the skills installed on disk, so a new skill appears without starting a new conversation.
description.zh: 让已打开会话的斜杠技能菜单与磁盘上的技能实时同步，新装技能无需新开会话即可出现。

description.en: Five switchable interface skins, each with its own animated boot sequence and synthesized sound design.
description.zh: 五套可切换的界面皮肤，每套配专属开机动画与合成音效。

description.en: 3D preview for BrickLink Studio .io LEGO models in the DSH sidebar: orbit and zoom the real LDraw geometry, see the part count, and load parts missing from the bundled set from a local Studio install on demand. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏预览 BrickLink Studio 的 .io 乐高模型：旋转缩放真实 LDraw 几何、显示件数，内置零件之外的部分按需从本机 Studio 安装读取。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Heuristic cost preflight for a draft message before it is sent. Message length over 500 characters, multi-step keywords, more than three referenced file paths, and test/verify/deploy words each add one tier (0-1 low, 2 medium, 3+ high), scaled by loose/standard/aggressive thresholds. Shows a 500ms-debounced tier badge beside the send button, a one-line high-cost hint above the input, an enable switch, a settings card, and exposes a cost_preflight tool. No token counting and no model calls.
description.zh: 发送前的启发式成本预检：草稿超过 500 字、含循环/遍历/逐个/所有/批量/接着/然后/之后等多步关键词、引用文件路径超过 3 个、含测试/验证/部署各加一档（0–1 低、2 中、3+ 高），宽松/标准/激进三档只移动切线；发送按钮旁显示 500ms 防抖的档位标签，高成本时在输入框上方给一行提示，另有启用开关、设置卡片与 cost_preflight 工具。不做 token 精确计费，不调用模型。

description.en: Project pi providers, models, API keys, and reasoning levels into the DSH model picker with watched configuration updates.
description.zh: 将 pi 的提供商、模型、API 密钥和思考等级投影到 DSH 模型选择器，并监听配置变化自动更新。

description.en: Checks Chinese government document drafts against GB/T 9704 formatting rules, auto-fixes deterministic issues, and exports a compliant .docx.
description.zh: 校验中文公文草稿的 GB/T 9704 格式，自动修复可以确定的问题，并导出排版规范的 .docx。

description.en: Play Gonic/Subsonic libraries in the DSH Web GUI with search, playlists, queues, and agent-controlled browser playback.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面播放 Gonic/Subsonic 曲库，支持搜索、歌单、队列和 Agent 指令浏览器播放。

description.en: MCP bridge for the running DeepSeek Harness desktop: 26 tools over a loopback MCP endpoint let Antigravity, Claude Code, Codex or Cursor drive the same live sessions, answer approvals and questions from the MCP side, keep per-session interaction modes, and use a reconnecting stdio proxy with a no-duplicate replay policy.
description.zh: 在运行中的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用内提供回环 MCP 端点：26 个工具让 Antigravity、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 驱动同一批实时会话，从 MCP 侧答复审批与提问，按会话保留交互模式，并提供断线重连、不重复执行的 stdio 代理。

description.en: Find existing GEO projects and reports and review sample coverage, competitors, and citations with read-only Zhixing Ark authorization.
description.zh: 知行方舟 GEO 品牌可见度，查询已有项目和报告，查看样本口径、竞品和引用。

description.en: Query CRM customers, leads, opportunities, follow-ups, and personal tasks with read-only Zhixing Ark authorization.
description.zh: 知行方舟 CRM 跟进，查询客户、线索、商机、跟进记录和本人待办。

description.en: OpenDesign in DeepSeek Harness: fills in the reasoning-effort levels an OpenDesign model API is missing, leaving any the user already set alone, and shows the used percentage of the 5-hour and weekly quotas as a pill in the conversation header, visible only while the session runs an OpenDesign model.
description.zh: 为 OpenDesign 模型 API 自动补齐缺失的思考深度档位（用户已设的不动），并在对话右上角显示 5 小时与 1 周额度的已用百分比；只在当前会话使用 OpenDesign 模型时出现。

description.en: Query ERP inventory, replenishment, purchase orders, and sales contracts with read-only Zhixing Ark authorization.
description.zh: 知行方舟 ERP 履约，查询库存、补货量、采购单和销售合同。

description.en: Query MES production progress, work orders, reports, and existing bills of materials with read-only Zhixing Ark authorization.
description.zh: 知行方舟 MES 生产跟踪，查询生产进度、工单、报工和已有 BOM。

description.en: Create timed product video scripts with shots, voiceover, and captions, and link to the Zhixing Ark content workspace.
description.zh: 知行方舟品牌短视频脚本，根据商品卖点生成分镜、口播和字幕，并提供品牌内容工作台入口。

description.en: Query manufacturing orders, shortages, stock alerts, production progress, and lot traceability with read-only Zhixing Ark authorization.
description.zh: 知行方舟制造业进销存，按企业只读授权查询订单、缺料、库存预警、生产进度和批次追溯。

description.en: Adds a button beside the workspace header that opens a VS Code .code-workspace file as one multi-root Workspace and starts a new Session in it. Folders are linked under $DSH_HOME/multiroot (junction on Windows, symlink elsewhere); only the chosen file is read. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在「工作区」标题旁加一个按钮：选择 .code-workspace 文件后，把其中的目录链接成一个多根工作区并在其中新开会话（Windows 用 junction，其他平台用软链接，聚合目录位于 $DSH_HOME/multiroot）。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: One-click session title regeneration for the current session: a labelled button beside the title, a row in the session header menu, the /retitle command, and a retitle_session agent tool, all calling the composed session-title service's explicit refresh.
description.zh: 一键重新生成当前会话的标题：标题旁的按钮、会话头部菜单里的一行、/retitle 命令，以及 retitle_session 智能体工具，都调用当前组合的会话标题服务的显式刷新。

description.en: A DSH sidebar panel that embeds the Huobao Drama short-video studio Web UI in an iframe, plus 19 huobao_* bridge tools for the local backend (health, drama and model CRUD, generation tasks, config and media APIs).
description.zh: DSH 侧栏面板，将「火宝短剧」短视频创作工作台 Web UI 以 iframe 嵌入；另提供 19 个 huobao_* 桥接工具，对接本地后端（健康检查、短剧与模型增删改查、生成任务、配置与媒体接口）。
